'''Vessex Ulgo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and [[Bouris Ulgo]]'s son who served as a member of [[House Ulgo]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. During the [[Alderaan Civil War]] Vessex tried to expose [[House of Thul]]'s use of dirty methods but was stopped by an Imperial-aligned individual in the [[Drovis Cave]].
